mapper.sql: cps.id AS id, cps.description AS description, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(egroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM egroups WHERE egroups.id IN (SELECT egroup_id FROM crm_pipeline_setting_egroups WHERE crm_pipeline_setting_id = cps.id)) AS employeeGroupName, GROUP_CONCAT(cos.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS stageName, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(FORMAT(cpss.percent, 0), '%') SEPARATOR ', ') AS percentage, GROUP_CONCAT(cpss.ordering SEPARATOR ', ') AS ordering, cps.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cps.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM crm_pipeline_settings AS cps LEFT JOIN crm_pipeline_setting_stags AS cpss ON cpss.crm_pipeline_setting_id = cps.id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_stags AS cos ON cos.id = cpss.crm_opportunity_stag_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cps.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cps.modified_by

WHERE cps.is_active = 1 AND cps.id IN ( SELECT crm_pipeline_setting_id FROM crm_pipeline_setting_egroups WHERE egroup_id IN ( SELECT egroup_id FROM employee_egroups WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ) )
AND cps.description LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_pipeline_settings(description, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{pipeline.description}, NOW(), #{pipeline.createdBy}, #{pipeline.isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_pipeline_settings SET description = #{pipeline.description}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{pipeline.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{pipeline.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE crm_pipeline_settings SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_pipeline_setting_stags(crm_pipeline_setting_id, crm_opportunity_stag_id, percent, ordering, is_skippable) VALUES (#{pipelineId}, #{stageId}, #{percent}, #{ordering}, #{skippable})
mapper.select: SELECT cpss.crm_opportunity_stag_id AS stageId, cos.name AS stageName, cpss.percent AS percent, cpss.ordering AS ordering, cpss.is_skippable AS skippable FROM crm_pipeline_setting_stags AS cpss INNER JOIN crm_opportunity_stags AS cos ON cos.id = cpss.crm_opportunity_stag_id WHERE cpss.crm_pipeline_setting_id = #{pipelineId} ORDER BY cpss.ordering ASC
